mapper.select: SELECT v.`id`, v.`shop_id`, v.`title`, v.`sub_title`, v.`rules`, v.`pay_value`, v.`actual_value`, v.`type`, v.`status`, v.`create_time`, sv.`stock`, sv.`begin_time`, sv.`end_time`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_voucher_order o WHERE o.voucher_id = v.id AND o.user_id = #{userId}) AS bought FROM tb_voucher v LEFT JOIN tb_seckill_voucher sv ON v.id = sv.voucher_id WHERE v.shop_id = #{shopId} AND v.status = 1 ORDER BY v.type DESC, v.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_seckill_voucher SET stock = stock - 1 WHERE voucher_id = #{voucherId} AND stock > 0 AND (begin_time IS NULL OR begin_time <= NOW()) AND (end_time IS NULL OR end_time >= NOW())
UPDATE tb_seckill_voucher SET stock = stock + 1 WHERE voucher_id = #{voucherId} AND stock > 0
